name: SCMBench
description: Benchmark of 19 domain-specific models and four single-cell foundation models (scGPT, UCE, Geneformer, scFoundation) for paired and unpaired single-cell multi-omics (RNA and ATAC) integration, scored on integration accuracy, biomarker detection, trajectory conservation and batch correction.

attributes.scope_note: Foundation models receive scATAC-seq as MAESTRO gene activity scores, a non-standard input for RNA-pretrained models (Methods).

name: FM-scVI (SCMBench adapter)
description: SCMBench authors' adapter: embeddings from a foundation model fed to scVI; the foundation model is the best one per dataset (scGPT on PBMC-10k, adapted UCE on Ma-2020, per the Fig. 2 legend).

attributes.training_setting: Foundation model embeddings with an scVI integration module
attributes.source_locator: Fig. 2 legend; Results on FM adaptation
limitations: The underlying foundation model differs by dataset.
